pali.definition: n. an ancient Prakrit language (derived from Sanskrit) that is the scriptural and liturgical language of Theravada Buddhism

palification.definition:
n. The act or practice of driving piles or posts into
   the ground to make it firm.

paliform.definition:
a. Resembling a palus; as, the paliform lobes of the septa
   in corals.

palikar.translation: (1821-1828 年独立战争时的)希腊民兵

palilalia.definition: n a pathological condition in which a word is rapidly and involuntarily repeated

palimony.definition: n. support paid by one half of an unmarried partnership after the relationship ends
palimony.translation: n. <美>（非婚同居者分居后经法院判定由一方付给另一方的）同居生活费, 同居津贴

palimpsest.definition: n. a manuscript (usually written on papyrus or parchment) on which more than one text has been written with the earlier writing incompletely erased and still visible

palimpsests.definition:
plural of palimpsest
n. a manuscript (usually written on papyrus or parchment) on which more than one text has been written with the earlier writing incompletely erased and still visible
palimpsests.translation: (palimpsest 的复数) n. 重写本, 覆画

n. 回文, 回文结构

palindromes.translation: n. 回文（指顺读和倒读都一样的词语）( palindrome的复数形式 )

paling.definition:
n a fence made of upright pickets

palingenetic.translation: a. 新生的, 轮回的

palingenist.translation: n. [宗]相信灵魂转生说的人

n. An ode recanting, or retracting, a former one; also, a
   repetition of an ode.
n. A retraction; esp., a formal retraction.
